content.description: Kontigo is a stablecoin super app built for Latinos across the United States and Latin America, giving them a USDC-smart global account to store, send, and spend digital dollars. It generates MPC-secured wallets for each user, supporting Bitcoin and Ethereum-based assets, so people can hold USDC, make instant cross-border transfers, and spend without the high fees and delays of traditional remittance channels. Aimed at emerging-market users who need dependable access to dollars, Kontigo wraps stablecoin infrastructure in a consumer-friendly banking experience with a card for everyday purchases. Backed by a $20 million seed round, it focuses on making stablecoins a simple, familiar way for Latino families and workers to save in dollars and move money between the US and their home countries.
content.meta: Kontigo is a USDC-smart stablecoin super app and global account for Latinos. Discover Kontigo and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
